title: Local illegal move remains atomic and a legal opening updates exact squares and journal
description:
Local illegal move remains atomic and a legal opening updates exact squares and journal

1. ACTION: Navigate to the configured local tunnel root / in a fresh isolated browser context; no login. Reset only that test origin storage if reused. Use real UI actions, no game-state injection. Wait for 64 #board-access .square-hit buttons. Coordinate buttons have data-testid square-X and exact data-piece codes wp/bp/wn/bn etc. Between moves wait #game-status[data-moving=false][data-thinking=false] (allow 15 seconds for 4.26-second captures and computer work). On compact layouts use #field-options (Field kit) to reveal mode and #studies controls; close open dialogs before board actions. Each study PRESELECTS its source, so click its destination directly. History #move-history li represents a fullmove with two SAN spans; empty history contains .history-empty. Decorative .sketch-piece images are not input targets. Assertions must inspect actual board/history/turn state, never URL-only.

2. ACTION: Open Field kit. Choose With a friend [data-mode=local]. If necessary use Begin a new game and confirm Begin again; close kit. Snapshot all 64 data-piece values, #move-history, #field-capture-count, #game-status data-turn. Select e2 then attempt e5.

3. ASSERTION: All 64 squares, move history, turn and capture count remain unchanged: e2=wp, e5 empty, White turn, captures00.

4. ACTION: The e2 source stays selected after the illegal destination: click e4 directly, wait settled; select e7 then e5, wait settled. Open Journal via #field-notes.

5. ASSERTION: e2/e7 empty, e4=wp,e5=bp; White turn, captures00. Journal SAN exactly e4 then e5; no extra ply. No fallback board or console exception.

title: Capture story resolves to the winner and Undo restores both original characters
description:
Capture story resolves to the winner and Undo restores both original characters

1. ACTION: Navigate to the configured local tunnel root / in a fresh isolated browser context; no login. Reset only that test origin storage if reused. Use real UI actions, no game-state injection. Wait for 64 #board-access .square-hit buttons. Coordinate buttons have data-testid square-X and exact data-piece codes wp/bp/wn/bn etc. Between moves wait #game-status[data-moving=false][data-thinking=false] (allow 15 seconds for 4.26-second captures and computer work). On compact layouts use #field-options (Field kit) to reveal mode and #studies controls; close open dialogs before board actions. Each study PRESELECTS its source, so click its destination directly. History #move-history li represents a fullmove with two SAN spans; empty history contains .history-empty. Decorative .sketch-piece images are not input targets. Assertions must inspect actual board/history/turn state, never URL-only.

2. ACTION: Open Field kit then Explore the chess studies and choose Tea on the sidelines [data-study=bloom]. This preselects e4. Activate d5 directly. Observe capture-skirmish/capture-stretcher if possible but do not click squares to skip. Wait board settled. The preset FEN starts on FULLMOVE2 (ends w KQkq - 0 2), not fullmove1. Amber means White, Indigo means Black.

3. ASSERTION: e4 empty,d5=wp,Black turn,one exd5 ply,capture count01,31 direct .sketch-cast>.sketch-piece residents. No .sketch-skirmish, .sketch-stretcher or .is-awaiting-stretcher remains after settling. .capture-pageant data-total-count=1. Both teams have character mittens.

4. ACTION: Click Undo last turn and wait settled.

5. ASSERTION: e4=wp,d5=bp,White turn,empty recorded history,captures00,32 direct resident sprites,no stale duel/stretcher or memorial. Pawn artwork/role matches restored squares. Restored turn label MUST be Amber to move (White), counter MUST remain Move02 because that is the initial custom study FEN; Undo MUST be disabled because recorded study history is empty. These observations are correct, not inconsistency. Make all capture-state assertions BEFORE clicking Undo, and only restored-state assertions AFTER Undo; never assert the mutually exclusive captured state after Undo.
